name: Circle of Owl Stones
description: Eight boulders resembling fluffed-up owls stand in a woodland clearing.

scenes.name: Watching Stones
scenes.description: No matter which direction you approach from, the eyes of the eight stone owls seem to follow you.

scenes.name: Stone Feather
scenes.description: A long stone feather stands at the center of the circle. A thin seam runs along it, and a narrow slit is visible at its base.

scenes.name: Moon Moss
scenes.description: The northern sides of the boulders are covered in pale moss that glows even during the day.
